summary:
“It’s stupid,” Shane says, then bites his lip, like he’s thinking about what to say. “You know that conversation I had with Hayden?”
Ilya doesn’t think he could forget it. He considers playing stupid just to rile Shane up, but decides against it when he sees the pinched, anxious expression on Shane’s face. “Yes, I remember.”
“It made me think about… I mean, I know you’re not actually my sugar baby. Or a baby at all, I mean.”
I could be, Ilya thinks, I will be whatever you want me to be. “But?”
“I’ve never given you anything.”
“...This is true.” It’s not like Ilya’s given him anything, though. He turns the idea over in his mind a moment-- there are lots of things he’d like to give Shane. Nice cars, fitted suits, soft sweaters and a dog and a house and a diamond ring.
Probably Shane would buy the house, though. Real estate fetish, and all.
“I wanted to, though. I mean, I have wanted to. Buy you stuff.”
